protocols.description: Randomize spatial/temporal order while preserving first-order statistics to test for relational structure.
Substitute neighbor accessibility with random graph connections to test for local reach constraints.
Systematically remove individual operators (e.g., set CSI=0) to verify their irreducible contribution to the signature.
Inject white noise up to the threshold of the predicted signature to measure robustness.
Force mismatch signals (ℰ) to remain strictly below the declared distinguishability floor (θ) and verify that no discrete selection events occur.
Apply a known selection sequence, then attempt to reverse the admissibility manifold deformation by applying inverse update pressure to test for ratchet irreversibility.

governance_rules.rule: Every evidence campaign must report the result of at least three mandatory falsification protocols.

required_statement: Observed signatures are interpreted only through restricted local analog structure.
